title: Thermal-Aware Scheduling for Heterogeneous CPU-GPU Systems
problem: Efficiently scheduling tasks across heterogeneous CPU-GPU systems while managing thermal constraints that can limit performance and reliability. Traditional schedulers fail to account for thermal dynamics when mapping workloads across different core types.
motivation: Thermal management is critical for maintaining reliability and performance in modern heterogeneous processors where different compute units have varying power and thermal dissipation characteristics.
method: The algorithm dynamically maps tasks to CPU and GPU cores based on real-time thermal state and task characteristics. It continuously monitors core temperatures and adjusts task allocation to prevent thermal violations. The approach integrates thermal feedback as a first-class constraint in scheduling decisions, optimizing performance within a fixed power envelope.
key_novelty: Dynamic task scheduling that integrates real-time thermal monitoring and constraints as a primary optimization target alongside performance in heterogeneous CPU-GPU systems.
contributions: Thermal-aware dynamic scheduling algorithm for heterogeneous CPU-GPU systems
Real-time thermal feedback mechanism for scheduling decisions
Task-to-core mapping strategy balancing thermal constraints and performance
Experimental validation achieving 25% performance improvement within the same power envelope
